confirmation_promotion.rule: Luna original gate against both references; nano supported/material-error non-regression against both

decision.reason: The candidate failed the frozen token objective against unchanged PASR; two provider failures retain unknown usage. The explicitly approved continuation also forbids automatic promotion. No retrieval-default change is justified.

accounting.scope: Answering-model API requests only; authoring, coding and semantic-review assistant-session tokens are excluded and unmeasured. Published-rate arithmetic is not an invoice.

design.source_scope: Production Python files from four pinned repositories; not an unrestricted repository-editing benchmark.
design.bootstrap_unit: Question, paired across arms. Independence across questions is an analytical assumption, not established by this study.
design.review: AI-mediated, label-blind semantic review against frozen source-bound compound criteria; not independent human auditing or ordinary answer accuracy.
design.failed_attempts: Retained without replacement; unknown provider usage is not zero. Full N=40 means remain unknown where a request has unknown usage.

methods.unit: Local o200k_base tokens in the full MCP text envelope, not cumulative provider usage or a quality score.

measurement.timing_policy: single ordered call per mode per development case; setup separately reported; warm process caches possible
measurement.parameter_coverage: all public methods, discrete semantic/recall/direction/outline modes and receipt/pack paths; representative numeric/free-text arguments, not Cartesian combinations

canonical_budget_disclosure.explanation: Canonical default_receipt_setup explicitly passes 1000, not the production 1500 default. Receipt explanation and expansion reuse that 1000-token selection. Included output tokens count the whole serialized MCP text, including metadata, escaped context, receipts and diagnostics; a context budget is not a cap on local output.
canonical_budget_disclosure.argument_resolution: Exact per-case arguments are retained per mode below. Missing arguments use live schema/handler defaults; listed schema defaults are observational, not newly applied arguments.
canonical_budget_disclosure.base_probe_definition: query=development probe symbol; files/include=oracle supplied production paths; ranged files cover lines 1 through min(80,file length).

limitations: All 12 cases are development cases on four Python corpora; gold file/symbol hints make this oracle-scoped, not discovery performance.
Every public tool and all 35 measured method-mode pairs are represented on every case; numeric/free-text arguments are representative, not exhaustive or Cartesian combinations.
All-mode means depend on chosen mode mix (17 select_context modes versus one receipt mode); compare descriptively, not as a ranking of interchangeable tools.
Local o200k_base output-text tokens exclude tool schemas, request prompts, provider framing, conversation replay, cached-input billing and answer tokens; they are not provider cumulative usage.
Receipt/pack setup calls are included separately as real calls; reuse introduces dependencies among mode observations.
Single ordered observations allow warm process/model/index caches; elapsed times are not a cold-start benchmark or statistically replicated latency experiment.
All 420 final calls succeeded, but success/status alone is not task correctness or retrieval quality.
No confirmation questions inspected, no provider/API calls made for this report, no production/study files modified.

invalid_baseline_disclosure.reason: Upstream initial_instructions was missing in the original agent-context bootstrap. Original observations are retained, not used as the corrected competitor baseline. Corrected Serena was measured separately with the upstream manual counted in provider input.

evidence_first4.prompt_suffix: Use only production source files; documentation, tests and manual files are not in this workspace. Start with a short identifier-focused search_code query, not the entire question, and reuse the returned paths and line ranges. For read_code, always provide BOTH a nonempty query and a files array; put ranges inside files as path:start-end, never in path/start/end arguments. After locating the implementation, prefer a focused read over repeated broad searches; follow direct helpers when their behavior matters. Search hits and signatures alone are not behavioral proof. Inspect relevant input normalization, helper defaults, branch bounds, composition order and return/error paths; distinguish truthiness from explicit None checks exactly as the code does. Before answering, check every requested clause against the implementation you read and explain the relevant helper/default effects explicitly. Stop once those mechanisms are evidenced; state any remaining omission rather than substituting prior knowledge.

selection_evidence.rule: Luna supported descending, material-error-answer count ascending, complete provider-token mean ascending, arm name
selection_evidence.adjudication_selection_sensitivity: The fixed-duration consistency correction adds one supported answer to each candidate, leaving their ranking unchanged. Original pre-adjudication reviews retained.
selection_evidence.development_result: Selected evidence_first4 has 2/12 full-support and zero material-error answers on Luna, but uses more tokens than native and unchanged split-4. Development is not promotion; confirmation still tests the frozen best-ranked candidate without retuning.

held_out_gate.rule: Luna original gate against both references; nano supported/material-error non-regression against both

excluded: Raw provider responses and encrypted replay state
export_policy.originals: Original private rows and measurement files remain unchanged locally. Original file/row hashes bind derived exports; public file hashes below bind the actual distributed bytes.
export_policy.microbenchmark_redaction: Each microbenchmark export redacts 12 personal-home prefixes in returned_text after measurement. Original measured token counts and source text/file hashes are retained; those redacted strings need not retokenize identically.
export_policy.grading: All 400 held-out semantic reviews are final and unmodified. Strict compound-criterion support is not ordinary accuracy; grader qualifications are retained.
export_policy.licenses: Production source snapshots and actual competitor licenses are included under sources/ and licenses/.

limitations: These are actual competitor context providers under a shared answer harness, not complete Aider/Serena coding-agent products.
Candidate changes were limited to the two frozen policies; no third candidate or held-out retuning.
The same four repositories were used across splits; concept overlap and model pretraining overlap are not excluded.
Low strict full-support counts do not imply that every unsupported answer is incorrect.
Some criteria demand unprompted implementation details; reviewer qualifications and original criteria are retained.
Known published-rate charges and conservative reservations are not invoices; authoring/coding/review assistant tokens are excluded and unmeasured.
No production retrieval-default change or universal product-superiority claim follows from this study.
